messages:
emma (product): Heads-up: incoming customer ask — ACME wants SSO + user provisioning for the marketplace connector, plus Terraform provisioning and an improved JS SDK auth flow. Putting here to triage. Ticket: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/1248. Thoughts on scope and priority?
intake-bot: New intake created: INT-1248 and placed in product-intake queue. @emma please add customer impact details and any docs.
liz (sales): Customer is a paying mid-market with SSO across 3 products. They need SCIM for users + Terraform to provision connector in their infra. Deal is contingent on integration timeline.
olivia (support): Adding repro + logs to the ticket. See drive: https://drive.redwood/notes/INT-1248. They see 403 when provisioning and occasional oauth token refresh failures.
raj (eng-platform): Quick triage view: two parallel workstreams: (A) SCIM + SSO fix in connector (auth race causing the 403s), (B) Terraform module + examples. SCIM/SSO has higher customer impact and blocks the deal.
kevin (sdk): For JS SDK we should fix the token refresh race that breaks SSO flows. Minimal patch + v2.1.1 release. Also add a short example for OIDC flows: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ authProvider: 'oidc', enableAutoRefresh: true });
await client.connect();
```
emma (product): Proposed MVP scope: 1) SCIM user provisioning (support AD/Okta) 2) Fix JS SDK token refresh + add examples 3) Terraform module as a stretch goal (docs + samples). Rollout: canary to Dedicated customers -> broader marketplace listing.
raj (eng-platform): Estimates rough: SCIM backend + auth fix = ~2 sprints with 2 engineers, JS SDK patch = ~3 days, Terraform module = ~1 sprint (docs/tests). Risks: security review and KMS/HSM requirements for Private deployments.
olivia (support): Customer can accept staged rollout; they want SCIM first. Marking SCIM as P1, Terraform P2 from support side.
emma (product): Backlog tags to apply: integration:identity-provisioning, sdk:js, infra:terraform, priority:P1-SCIM, customer:ACME. Anyone disagree?
liz (sales): :thumbsup: no objections, sales ok with staged approach.
kevin (sdk): I'll own SDK patch and examples. @raj can you pick eng lead for SCIM?
raj (eng-platform): I'll take eng lead for SCIM and open up subtasks in INT-1248 (auth fix, scim endpoints, acceptance tests).
intake-bot: INT-1248 updated with tags: integration:identity-provisioning, sdk:js, infra:terraform, customer:ACME. Assigned to product-intake.
emma (product): Scheduling 30m triage tomorrow 11:00 PT. Agenda: confirm acceptance criteria (SCIM sync success, no 403s on provisioning), rollout milestones, owner assignments, and mapping to Dedicated vs Hosted flows. If blocked by security review, flag immediately.
olivia (support): I'll prepare failure logs and a reproducible test case for the triage.
liz (sales): I'll share the staged rollout proposal with the customer after triage.
kevin (sdk): Noted — will have the JS SDK patch PR ready for review by end of next week.
raj (eng-platform): I'll flag the KMS/HSM dependency and get a contact from security in the meeting.
emma (product): Perfect. Closing comments here — we'll use INT-1248 as the source of truth. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
